ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISBLANK( Opportunity__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'IR'), ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'Assessment'), ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'MSP End User') ),
NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must select an Opportunity when POC Category is IR, Assessment, or MSP End User.
